key_features: ACTIVE NOISE REDUCTION (ANR): Active Noise Reduction (ANR) - Patent No. [11,875,769 B2] technology which filters out fans, air purifiers, heaters, and air conditioners, so what you hear is your baby, not static.

CRYSTAL CLEAR DAY/NIGHT VISION: See your baby in perfect detail. From your bed, simply press a button to pan, tilt, or zoom the camera — no need to open the nursery door or disturb your little one.

YOUR BABY, ONLY YOUR EYES: No WiFi. No app. No cloud. No hacking worries. A super-secure direct signal beams straight from the camera to your screen. No internet connection means total peace of mind: the only one watching your little one is you.

SWAP LENS IN SECONDS: The only baby monitor that lets you change lenses instantly. Use the included standard lens for most rooms or switch to the included zoom lens to catch every tiny detail from across the nursery. For a full-room view, simply add the wide-angle lens (sold separately).
